about: Per-stage latency of commanding a DeepRacer over the internet. Each stage is lognormal given by median and p99 (sigma = ln(p99/median) / 2.326). loss = probability a one-way leg needs a TCP retransmit (+rto_ms). All values are estimates until replaced by tools/measure_latency.py output from a real car.

wifi_one_way.note: 802.11ac last hop; retries and power-save spikes

onboard_api.note: nginx auth_request to /auth + Flask handler on the Atom

onboard_service_call.note: extra for routes that call a ROS service synchronously (start_stop, drive_mode, battery)

ros_to_servo.note: manual_drive topic -> ctrl_node -> servo_node, before waiting for the next PWM frame

camera_capture_to_stream.note: exposure + capture + MJPEG encode + web stream

new_connection: one extra round trip for TCP, one for TLS 1.3, over the whole path

tunnel-us.note: cloud sandbox (US) -> tunnel edge -> home broadband (US)

tunnel-intl.note: sandbox and car on different continents

use: When the twin runs behind a real tunnel the internet leg is real: use wan none. wan profiles are for local runs only.
